manifest.name: supergraph
manifest.description: Evidence-gated engineering workflows, 7 specialized subagents, and native Rust CDP browser/API automation for AI coding agents
manifest.author: datit309

bundle.text:
# Supergraph plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
- insert:
    - id: supergraph
      name: supergraph
    - id: mcp-codebase-memory
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: codebase-memory
        transport: stdio
        command: codebase-memory-mcp
        args: []
        reconnect:
          enabled: true
          maxAttempts: 20
          initialDelayMs: 1000
          maxDelayMs: 30000
    - id: mcp-serena
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: serena
        transport: stdio
        command: serena
        args: ['start-mcp-server', '--context=codex', '--project-from-cwd']
        reconnect:
          enabled: true
          maxAttempts: 20
          initialDelayMs: 1000
          maxDelayMs: 30000
    - id: mcp-supergraph-team
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: supergraph-team
        transport: stdio
        command: node
        args:
          - !!js >-
            (() => {
              const path = process.getBuiltinModule('node:path');
              const req = process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl);
              try {
                return path.join(path.dirname(req.resolve('supergraph/package.json')), 'plugins/supergraph/bin/sg-team-mcp.js');
              } catch {
                return path.join(path.dirname(req.resolve('./package.json')), 'bin/sg-team-mcp.js');
              }
            })()
        reconnect:
          enabled: true
          maxAttempts: 20
          initialDelayMs: 1000
          maxDelayMs: 30000
    - id: mcp-supergraph-browser
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: supergraph-browser
        transport: stdio
        command: node
        args:
          - !!js >-
            (() => {
              const path = process.getBuiltinModule('node:path');
              const req = process.getBuiltinModule('node:module').createRequire(baseUrl);
              try {
                return path.join(path.dirname(req.resolve('supergraph/package.json')), 'plugins/supergraph/bin/sg-browser-mcp.js');
              } catch {
                return path.join(path.dirname(req.resolve('./package.json')), 'bin/sg-browser-mcp.js');
              }
            })()
        reconnect:
          enabled: true
          maxAttempts: 20
          initialDelayMs: 1000
          maxDelayMs: 30000
    - id: mcp-ui-skills
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: ui-skills
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://www.ui-skills.com/mcp
        reconnect:
          enabled: true
          maxAttempts: 20
          initialDelayMs: 1000
          maxDelayMs: 30000
    - id: preset-supergraph
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: supergraph
        name: 'Supergraph Engineer'
        description: 'Tối ưu token: Graph-first, Serena AST, Strict Log Pruner, TDD Mandatory'
        order: 0
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: >-
                You are a senior full-stack software engineer powered by the {{model}} model.
                You strictly follow the Supergraph workflow: Scan -> Plan -> Execute (Supergraph Team DAG) -> Auto-fix -> Verify.
                CRITICAL: Always prioritize Codebase Memory MCP (search_graph, trace_path, detect_changes) and Serena MCP (find_symbol, get_symbols_overview, get_diagnostics_for_file) over brute-force file reading.
                When executing approved plans with multiple tasks or waves, ALWAYS invoke /supergraph:execute and activate Supergraph Team (sg_team_init, sg_task_create) to isolate git worktrees and stream progress to the Live Monitor dashboard (:3333).
                TOKEN EFFICIENCY: Be concise, direct, and technically exact. Eliminate conversational filler, pleasantries, and unnecessary explanations. Output code blocks, diffs, and exact terminal commands.
                UI/FRONTEND: Always prioritize UI Skills MCP (list_skills, get_skill) to enforce professional design standards (e.g. baseline-ui, fluid animation, accessibility) and validate with agent_browser_* before claiming done.
                NEXT ACTION: At the end of every response, always provide an explicit "👉 Tiếp theo nên làm gì:" recommendation with the exact single command/action and why.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until exit_plan_mode succeeds or the user switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
                  backgroundMode: continuable
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
                  backgroundMode: continuable
              - id: tool-subagent-codex
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: codex
                  toolName: subagent_codex
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed
              - id: tool-subagent-claude-code
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: claude-code
                  toolName: subagent_claude_code
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
              - id: tool-ralph
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ralph'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  subagentProvider: spawn
                  maxRounds: 64
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true

readme.text:
> [Tiếng Việt](./README-VI.md) · [Installation Guide](./docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [Workflow Examples](./docs/EXAMPLES.md) · [Team Setup](./plugins/supergraph/docs/TEAM-SETUP.md)

**Turn AI coding agents from code generators into disciplined engineering workflow systems.**

Supergraph enforces planning, TDD, verification, review, and architecture-aware decision making through mandatory workflows, graph intelligence, and LSP-powered code analysis across Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Google Antigravity, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

---

Every non-trivial change follows the strict engineering lifecycle:

`scan → analyze → plan → TDD → execute → fix → verify → review`

- **Knowledge Graph & Code Intelligence**: Powered by [Codebase Memory MCP](https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp) (`>= 0.10.8,<0.11.0`). Indexes repository state locally into `.codebase-memory/graph.db.zst` (cache in `~/.cache/codebase-memory-mcp`) via `index_repository`, providing mathematical blast radius, call hierarchy, dependency cycles, and test gaps. [Serena](https://github.com/oraios/serena) provides LSP-level symbol navigation and diagnostics.
- **7-Subagent Specialized Architecture**: Autonomous separation of concerns — `plan-writer` (planning), `plan-reviewer` (spec checks), `executor` (TDD execution), `qa-tester` (E2E browser/API testing), `security-auditor` (OWASP/Vibesec AppSec), `diagnostician` (root-cause debugging), and `code-reviewer` (independent merge verdict).
- **Autonomous Human Browser Agent & QA (`browser-agent`)**: Native Rust CDP (`agent-browser`, zero Playwright). Uses compact accessibility tree snapshots (`@ref`), bypasses anti-bot walls via real user profiles, generates 5-dimension ISTQB test matrices (UI + API + DB fault injection), and exports structured bug reports.
- **Unified Mobile Automation & Real Device QA (`mobile-agent`)**: Direct

On Windows, `hooks/run-hook.cmd` dynamically resolves Git Bash across standard and user-level paths. If Git Bash is not found, hooks skipped with a warning, keeping platform execution non-blocking.

macOS, Linux, or WSL (defaults to all platforms):
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datit309/supergraph/master/install.sh | sh
```

Windows PowerShell 5.1+:
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datit309/supergraph/master/install.ps1 | iex
```

*Security: Inspect installer scripts before piping remote code into a shell.*

Install for a specific platform:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datit309/supergraph/master/install.sh | sh -s -- --platform [claude|codex|antigravity|opencode|dsh|all]
```

Supergraph checks for newer versions at SessionStart (at most once every 24h). Update commands:
```text
Claude Code: /plugin marketplace update supergraph
Codex: codex plugin marketplace upgrade supergraph
Antigravity: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datit309/supergraph/master/install.sh | sh -s -- --platform antigravity
OpenCode: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datit309/supergraph/master/install.sh | sh -s -- --platform opencode
Set `SUPERGRAPH_UPDATE_CHECK=false` to disable. Note: OpenCode does not currently expose a SessionStart hook.

👉 **For manual clone & detailed per-platform steps, see [docs/INSTALLATION.md](./docs/INSTALLATION.md).**

---

| Skill | Purpose | When to use |
|---|---|---|
| `/supergraph:scan` | Scan project structure, build/verify graph | Start of every session |
| `/supergraph:explore` | Codebase exploration & architectural discovery | Complex research without code mutation |
| `/supergraph:analyze` | Graph risk analysis, blast radius, approaches | Ambiguous scope, hub/bridge nodes |
| `/supergraph:sdd` | Software Design Document with schemas | Formal architecture specs |
| `/supergraph:plan` | Implementation plan with embedded contracts | Before any non-trivial change |
| `/supergraph:tdd` | Strict Test-Driven Development (RED → GREEN) | Implementing any feature or bugfix |
| `/supergraph:execute` | Multi-worker Wave DAG execution (Worktrees) | Executing saved plans |
| `/supergraph:fix` | Plan-aware auto-fix loop (tests, lint, format) | After code changes complete |
| `/supergraph:integration`| Integration, contract, and DB test runs | After unit tests pass |
| `/supergraph:browser-agent`| ISTQB QA testing & human browser emulation | E2E web/API testing, anti-bot bypass |
| `/supergraph:mobile-agent` | Unified autonomous mobile testing across iOS & Android | Real device & emulator E2E testing (WDA &

1. **`plan-writer`:** Analyzes code graph and crafts plans (never writes code).
2. **`plan-reviewer`:** Independently reviews plans for spec alignment and completeness.
3. **`executor`:** Executes tasks inside isolated git worktrees with strict TDD.
4. **`qa-tester`:** Generates ISTQB test matrices and runs autonomous E2E browser & API tests.
5. **`security-auditor`:** Audits diffs against OWASP Top 10, IDOR, injection, and secrets.
6. **`diagnostician`:** Isolates minimal repros and diagnoses root causes scientifically.
7. **`code-reviewer`:** Independent final reviewer assessing diffs against requirements.

Supergraph Team coordinates multi-agent DAG execution with zero file conflicts:
- **Worktree Isolation:** Concurrent tasks run in isolated worktrees (`.supergraph/worktrees/`).
- **Live Monitor Dashboard:** Real-time DAG visualization at `http://127.0.0.1:3333`.

👉 **For complete team onboarding and branch strategy, see [plugins/supergraph/docs/TEAM-SETUP.md](./plugins/supergraph/docs/TEAM-SETUP.md).**

---

1. NEVER code without an approved plan.
2. NEVER implement without a verified failing RED test.
3. NEVER modify hub nodes without user approval.
4. NEVER skip the auto-fix loop.
5. NEVER commit if tests fail or review has CRITICAL findings.
6. ALWAYS query graph tools (`search_graph`, `trace_path`) before assuming relationships.
7. ALWAYS verify browser/API features with `browser-agent` (Rust CDP, zero Playwright) and mobile features with `mobile-agent`.
